layout_rationale.W5_SINGLE_W6_SINGLE_W7_SINGLE: move the same 10-bit logical field to other ChaCha key/state words and other round0 column groups
layout_rationale.W4_W8_SPLIT: two active key words inside round0 group0
layout_rationale.W4_W6_SPLIT: two active key words spanning different round0 groups

fresh_target_generation: shuffle logical IDs 1..1023 with Python random.Random(seed); exclude previously used/recovered b=10 target IDs; take first eight

stage_L0_structural_cost.method: propagate candidate-dependent state-word set through the exact fixed screen/direct QR schedules; a QR is candidate-dependent iff its input group intersects the current dependency set, after which all four group words become candidate-dependent

family_interpretation.broad_transfer: at least 4 of 5 non-control layouts pass every L1 layout gate
family_interpretation.partial_transfer: 2 or 3 non-control layouts pass every gate
family_interpretation.one_word_scope_only: 0 or 1 non-control layouts pass every gate

wall_policy: Wall-time benchmarking is forbidden until exact generic-vs-cached execution equivalence is implemented for a layout that passes L1. QR accounting and correctness decide L1, not Python timing.
claim_limit: No alpha<1 claim. No full-round claim. No layout may be added, removed, retuned, or reweighted after survivor results are observed.
next_if_transfer: implement exact generic multi-layout cache executor, prove bit-for-bit equivalence, then frozen wall benchmark on passing layouts
next_if_no_transfer: scope the admitted constant-factor win to the one-word word4 layout and pivot away from cache generality rather than retuning layouts
